# Pre-market brief, Wed Oct 21, 2026 (Research Inc., ~8:25 AM ET)

**AI trade bounces on SpaceX and Super Micro; oil back near $110 on Hormuz.**

1. **Futures:** Nasdaq 100 +0.66%, S&P +0.27%, Dow +0.17% at 7:52 AM ET. ([Markets Insider](https://markets.businessinsider.com/premarket), [Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-wednesday-october-21-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-100000105.html))
2. **AI relief:** SpaceX first profit since IPO lifted the AI trade; SMCI +16% pre after raising its quarter revenue view to $18.5–19.5B; CRWV, NBIS, NVDA, INTC +2–4% early pre; LITE +4%. Hedge funds cut tech at the fastest pace in a decade through Oct 15, and AI CDS sit at records, so treat this as a bounce, not an all-clear. ([Yahoo/Stocktwits](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nasdaq-futures-rise-premarket-spacex-084106939.html), [SMCI](https://x.com/i/trending/2112647056313471040), [X news](https://x.com/i/trending/2112266057628913774))
3. **Oil:** Brent ~$109–110, WTI ~$98 as Iran's IRGC reportedly blocks Hormuz tankers; Rubio says pressure stays until attacks stop. French 10y crossed 5%. ([Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-wednesday-october-21-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-100000105.html), [Yahoo/Stocktwits](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nasdaq-futures-rise-premarket-spacex-084106939.html), [X news](https://x.com/i/trending/2112849951126589933))
4. **Earnings movers:** NFLX −6% pre (ad forecast cut to $2.7B, soft Q4). ELV +1–2% pre: adj EPS $6.99 vs $4.70, FY guide ≥$29 from ≥$27. TMO up pre on $6.68 vs $6.40. T −3.3% pre despite beat and EPS raise. ABT −1.4% (in-line, Nutrition spinoff). ISRG −9% AH on $450M legal charge. UAL Q4 EPS guide $0.50–1.50 on $4.80 fuel. ([NFLX](https://money.usnews.com/investing/news/articles/2026-10-21/netflix-slides-as-weak-profit-ad-outlook-intensify-investor-anxiety), [ELV](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/elevance-health-beats-estimates-raises-104033930.html), [TMO](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4655063-thermo-fisher-stock-gains-on-q3-beat), [T](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/att-beats-estimates-but-stock-falls-premarket-4962391), [ABT](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/abbott-beats-revenue-estimates-shares-slide-amid-planned-nutrition-unit-spinoff-4962674), [ISRG](https://x.com/i/trending/2112647051355767160), [UAL](https://x.com/i/trending/2112656501483684033))
5. **Calendar:** Tonight TSLA, META, IBM, TXN, LRCX, LUV. EIA crude 10:30 today; claims Thu; flash PMIs Fri; FOMC Oct 28. ([WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/livecoverage/stock-market-today-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-10-21-2026/card/RqGPSuBDGYneg2mUSK2w))

## Ideas (long-only, swing)
- **ELV**: big EPS beat plus guide raise, membership-light but margin-led; fits the defensive health-care winner pattern. Conf: med. Risk: already +10% in two weeks; don't chase a gap past +3%.
- **TMO**: Q3 beat led by lab products and biopharma services. Conf: low. Risk: tools group trades with risk appetite, which flips if tonight's AI prints disappoint.

**Avoid changes:** keep semis/optics/AI-debt avoids through tonight's LRCX/TXN/META prints (one-day bounce isn't a clear signal), keep airlines (UAL weak Q4 guide, Brent ~$110), NFLX, SPCX lock-up, GM, GPC, BAC. Add ISRG ($450M legal charge, −9% AH).
